meta.summary: A hand-painted sign under a pink neon tube at 2am: near-black wall, sign-paint yellow headings, paper-white text, and neon pink for the one thing that has to glow. Fonts: Anton (wordmark, headings), Archivo (body), Permanent Marker (taped-up signs).

concept: A hand-painted sign under a pink neon tube at 2am. Black wall, yellow paint, paper signs taped up, one pink glow.

night.name: Wall black
night.role: Main background for posts, like the painted wall around the window.
night.rule: Posts are dark first, because the window is only ever seen at night. Night covers most of every post.

paper.name: Sign paper
paper.role: Body copy on night, and the background of taped-up signs and labels.
paper.rule: All small text is paper on night (16.7:1). On a paper label, text is night.

paint.name: Sign-paint yellow
paint.role: Headlines, the way the wall lettering is painted.
paint.rule: Headlines and big numbers only. 11.6:1 on night, so it can go fairly small, but keep it for the loudest line so it stays loud.

neon.name: Neon pink
neon.role: The wordmark, a price stamp, one underline.
neon.rule: One pink thing per post, like the one neon sign. 5.4:1 on night passes for text 32px and up; on paper it's 3.1:1, so large marker lettering (56px+) or a line only.

avoid.reason: Pink on yellow vibrates and fails contrast. Keep them on separate elements against night.

roles.note: Maps the shared post templates' color roles to this brand's colors. Templates only ever use roles, so the same layout works for every brand.
roles.heading: paint
roles.label: paper

material_notes: The neon reads hotter and blurrier in photos than the hex. Leave the glow as shot; the hex is for type and marks.
The fluorescent light inside the window is green-white. Don't warm it up in photos; it's what 2am looks like.

wordmark.description: Tall condensed capitals, like the banner over the window, in neon pink.
wordmark.rule: Two lines, all caps. The smaller SLICE line is spaced out so it reads like the neon tube underneath the banner.

heading.description: Condensed poster capitals, like the painted wall line. Write headlines in capitals; the font has no lowercase personality worth using.

body.description: A sturdy grotesk for prices, hours and anything that has to be read on a phone in a parking lot.
body.rule: Short lines, big enough to read at arm's length after a twelve-hour shift.

hand.description: Marker lettering, like a sign taped inside the window.
hand.rule: At most one marker element per post, a few words long: a price, an hour, a 'tonight only'.

shape.rule: Hard corners and crooked tape. Signs go up fast; nothing is centered with a ruler.
